title: Stalk presentation of one factor of a root product chart
statement: Let q:Z to Spec R be a scheme morphism, z in Z, f in the prime q(z), and e_k positive integers indexed by Fin m. Suppose alpha identifies Z over Spec R with the spectrum of the product of H_k=R[T]/(T^(e_k)-f). Set R0=O_(Spec R,q(z)). There exist k, f0 in the maximal ideal of R0, a maximal ideal P of D=R0[T]/(T^(e_k)-f0), and a ring isomorphism theta:O_(Z,z) to D_P respecting the structural map R0 to O_(Z,z). No etale or flatness hypothesis or conclusion is used.

source.place: Tags 0EYH and 0EYI: affine root charts, localization and base change of individual root factors

proof.text: PrimeSpectrum.sigmaToPi_bijective selects k and a prime w in H_k whose image is alpha(z). The spectrum map of evaluation at k is an open immersion (Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Limits); composing with alpha inverse gives an open immersion t:Spec H_k to Z with t(w)=z. The structural equality for alpha gives t followed by q equal to the canonical H_k structural map. These steps are proved in Lean.
Apply the single-factor base-stalk localization theorem to t followed by q and w. It provides the maximal prime P and the factor stalk isomorphism.

An open immersion has an isomorphism on stalks. Compose that isomorphism with the factor stalk isomorphism and use stalkMap_comp to prove structural compatibility; this is the private helper and explicit Lean composition calculation.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0EYH and 0EYI; localization argument written explicitly in the docstring, and Lean assembly by A4

mathlib_searches.query: The stalk at a prime of a monic root polynomial quotient is the localization of the quotient over the base stalk
Localization of AdjoinRoot polynomial commutes with localization of the coefficient ring
mathlib_searches.results: Polynomial.isLocalization (Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Algebra) gives polynomial localization, but not the quotient and prime-stalk identification; Localization.awayEquivAdjoin treats inverse adjunction only.

Localization.AtPrime.mapPiEvalRingHom_bijective, PrimeSpectrum.sigmaToPi_bijective and AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme sigmaSpec give the product-factor part. The private root_local lemma in StalkNormalizationTraitSectionRootPresentation is downstream and cannot be imported. No matching base-localization quotient theorem found.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Ingredients only; product-factor part proved in the delivery.

lean.statement:
theorem rootProductChart_stalk_localization_core {Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (q : Z ⟶ Spec R) (z : Z)
    (f : R) (hf : f ∈ (q z).asIdeal)
    (m : ℕ) (e : Fin m → ℕ) (he : ∀ k, 0 < e k)
    (α : Z ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of (∀ k : Fin m,
      AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ e k - Polynomial.C f))))
    (hα : α.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (algebraMap R (∀ k : Fin m,
        AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial R) ^ e k - Polynomial.C f)))) = q) :
    let R₀ := (Spec R).presheaf.stalk (q z)
    ∃ (k : Fin m) (f₀ : R₀), f₀ ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R₀ ∧
      let p := (Polynomial.X : Polynomial R₀) ^ e k - Polynomial.C f₀
      let D := AdjoinRoot p
      ∃ (P : Ideal D) (hP : P.IsMaximal),
        letI : P.IsPrime := hP.isPrime
        let E := Localization.AtPrime P
        ∃ θ : Z.presheaf.stalk z ≃+* E,
          θ.toRingHom.comp (q.stalkMap z).hom =
            (algebraMap D E).comp (AdjoinRoot.of p)
